description: This file defines custom Google Mock matchers and operator overloads for comparing specific data structures used in the Rialto server project, such as Rectangle and Fraction, and includes utility matchers for string and array comparisons.

methods.name: CharStrMatcher
methods.description: A Google Mock matcher that compares a string argument to an expected string.

methods.name: NotNullMatcher
methods.description: A Google Mock matcher that checks if a pointer argument is not null.

methods.name: arrayMatcher
methods.description: A Google Mock matcher that compares a byte array argument to a vector of expected bytes.
